query:
SELECT m.id, m.sponsorId, m.delegateName, m.delegateCompany, m.slotNumber, m.isRescheduled
FROM meetings m
WHERE m.delegateName LIKE '%Oliver%Brown%'
   OR (m.delegateName LIKE '%Oliver%' AND m.sponsorId IN (
       SELECT id FROM sponsors WHERE companyName LIKE '%Wilson%'
   ))
ORDER BY m.id;
